children: GIVBUX, INC. reported results for the quarter ended 2026, with revenue of $34.26K and a net loss of ($548.09K), an improvement versus the prior-year quarter when revenue was $55.8K and net loss was ($6.1M).
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “diluted loss per Common Share”.
Revenue decline to $34,264 from $55,803 year-over-year reflected reduced sales activity and lower gross profit, which fell to $6,851 from $16,369.
Primary revenues continued to come from limited sales of the GivBux SuperApp while the company shifts focus to an upgraded SuperApp.
Management is testing an improved SuperApp with enhanced functionality and AI integration targeted for a Sept. 30, 2026 relaunch.
Operating expenses were reduced as marketing and administrative spend were curtailed while preparing for the product relaunch.
